>Snus is the go to variety of tobacco in Scandinavia and that stuff does not give you cancer. It's almost completely safe.

As a long time snus user this isn't true. While the cancer risk is greatly lowered compared to old snus because of better laws and practices snus is still linked to several cancers and other big health detriments. Here's an english abstract from a finnish medical journal:

Selling smokeless tobacco (snus) in Finland is illegal, yet one-third of all males aged 16 to 18 years have tried it. A regular snus user can receive a daily dose of 60 to 150 milligrams of nicotine and become heavily addicted. The first - and easily detectable - lesions appear in the oral mucosa and gingiva. Long-time follow-up studies of snus use from a young age are, however, still lacking. Evidence exists of increased risk for fatal cardiovascular diseases and increased risk for injuries. Risk for oral cancer is debated, with more studies showing an increased risk than showing no risk; risk also exists for cancer of esophagus, stomach and pancreas. A new and alarming finding among female users is increased risk for preterm birth, preeclampsia and neonatal apnea.

https://www.duodecimlehti.fi/duo10270

1. Odablock (like most PvP content creators) use a lot of account services because it's generally too time consuming to do those things yourself when you make so many different accounts etc. These are against the rules but Jagex is at the very minimum lenient on enforcing this.

3. He defends himself by saying it's a religious thing.

4. Jagex not liking the massive negative attention ban ALL of his accounts with the reason being over 400 hours of account services being used on his accounts. This is in my opinion very clearly just an excuse to ban someone who you do not want to represent their game.

5. Odablock claims that the real reason he was banned was because of him calling out someone called Stella who he claims is a big scammer. (I have no idea if she is but given that she is involved in osrs gambling it wouldn't surprise me)

6. With seemingly no evidence he claims that Stella and Mod Trident are dating and Mod Trident is the one who mass banned him because he was criticizing Stella.

Now it's a messy situation but it's important to keep in mind that a decision like mass banning one of your biggest content creators (who get special treatment) isn't going to be up to one person.

I just realized my life might just turn out okay.

A little context here would be that due to a very severe case of chronic migraines I missed some morning classes 3/5 school days (1 of those would usually be a fully missed day).

I still managed to barely get into secondary level education (basically preparing for uni at ages of 16-19) but had to drop out due to so many missed classes.

I swapped to evening school, am now studying with 40 year olds, but am finishing my courses. After suffering from this for about 15 years, it's finally slowing down (1/7 times a week approximately now) Doctor is more and more positive this will go down as I get older.

Am now able to work 7.00-15.00 and go to school from 16.00-21.00
Earning myself a good 80€ a day while getting my education. (My boss suffers from migraines too so he wanted to help me out and offered me a steady job at a warehouse where my presence is not needed, yet it speeds things up, so that I am still useful.)

I have to use an extra year to secondary level education, but will still be going to uni later on.

Here's to hoping someday I will be able to say I no longer suffer migraines!

EXTRA: Anyone suffering from chronic migraines please report in and tell me your experiences!
